parts.title: A Sleepy Start
parts.text: The sun came up over the farm. Mia was **sleepy**, but she pulled on her boots. Omar and Ruby waited by the barn. “Let’s **gather** the eggs,” said Omar.

parts.title: The Hen House
parts.text: Ruby opened the little door. Mia used a **gentle** hand to lift each warm egg. A baby goat came to **nibble** her sleeve. Omar took a **peek** into a nest and found a chick. It began to **wiggle** in his hands.

parts.title: Rain and Mud
parts.text: Then the rain began. Ruby saw a big **puddle** by the gate. The goat gave a **bounce** and ran off in a **dash**. Back in the barn, Omar made a **tidy** pile of straw. Ruby put the chick in a **bundle** of hay, and it loved to **snuggle** close to Mia.

parts.title: A Happy Morning
parts.text: The rain stopped. The eggs were safe in the basket. The friends ate warm toast in the barn. It was a happy morning.
